repos.name: socioeconomic-hdi-predictor
repos.description: Web-based machine learning app that estimates Human Development Index from socio-economic indicators using a regression model with a Flask and Python interface.

repos.name: Open-LLM-Training-Platform
repos.description: An open-source platform for training, deploying, and evaluating large language models (LLMs). repos.name: Smart-Waste-Management-using-Artificial_Intelligence
repos.description: Smart Waste Management using AI leverages machine learning, IoT sensors, and predictive analytics to optimize waste collection, segregation, and recycling. The system reduces operational costs, minimizes environmental impact, and promotes sustainable urban living through intelligent automation.

repos.description: Fake news detection using machine learning leverages algorithms to classify news as real or fake by analyzing text patterns, context, and source credibility. Techniques like TF‑IDF, word embeddings, logistic regression, SVM, deep learning models (LSTM, BERT) help identify misinformation, ensuring reliable information and reducing harmful impacts.
repos.tldr: 機械学習を用いたフェイクニュース検出は、テキストパターンや文脈、情報源の信頼性を分析してニュースを真偽に分類し、TF-IDFや単語埋め込み、ロジスティック回帰、SVM、深層学習モデル（LSTM、BERT）などの技術を活用して誤情報を特定し、信頼性のある情報を提供する。
